outline: The course primarily discusses the visualization of scientific data such as scalars, vectors, tensors, volumes, and its applications on  finite-element based dynamic structural analysis. We will be using MATLAB to demonstrate and code up some of these concepts and applications along with some general tutorials on graphics and scientific visualization. Each student is encouraged to apply the scientific visualization techniques on his/her professional researches as a final report.
schedule:
Week 1: Introduction to scientific visualization
Week 2: Basic structural dynamics using OpenSees - SDOF modeling
Week 3: Earthquake ground motion data
Week 4: Basic graphics and computer graphics primer
Week 5: Data representation of structural dynamics
Week 6: Finite element data representation and data structure
Week 7: Nonlinear structural dynamics using OpenSees
Week 8: Research topics on final reports
---
Week 9: Midterm simulation
Week 10: Midterm
Week 11: Lighting and transparency
Week 12: Volume visualization
Week 13: Practices on dynamic structural analysis (1)
Week 14: Practices on dynamic structural analysis (2)
Week 15: Final report proposal presentations in English (1)
Week 16: Final report proposal presentations in English (2)
Week 17: Final report writing (1)
Week 18: Final report writing (2)
--
assessment:
Homework: 30%
Midterm: 30%
Final presentation and report: 40%
